description: Shared-additive paths for the agent claim board (scripts/lib/agent_claim_board.py). Almost every PR adds one row or one entry to these files and the merge is mechanical, so a claim on one of them never conflicts with another session's claim, never blocks a claim/take/next, and never blocks a commit. Each entry must be an exact path (no globs). Remove an entry to make the path exclusive again; a missing or unreadable file means no shared paths (the safer, exclusive default). Doc: docs/ops/AGENT_CLAIM_BOARD.md (Shared-additive paths).
